validate: set -e; tmp=$(mktemp -d); npm pack --pack-destination "$tmp"; cp -r starters/next-app "$tmp/starter"; cd "$tmp/starter"; npm install --save-exact "$tmp/majapisoftwares-ui-${version}.tgz"; npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm run check:ui; npm run build
afterPublish: set -e; cd starters/next-app; i=0; until npm install --save-exact --prefer-online "@majapisoftwares/ui@${version}"; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 30 ] && exit 1; sleep 10; done
